argon.name: Argon
argon.nativePlane: Solar latitude −6.455° cone, projected into J2000 ecliptic x/y
argon.qualification: Retained movie is the baseline run; the quantitative comet reference is the separate 224 × 48 × 240 run.

frameSequence.physicalInterpolation: Bounded linear interpolation of physical flux between actual native epochs before logarithmic colour mapping.
frameSequence.browserInterpolation: Linear RGB opacity crossfade between adjacent 30 min display-support images at requestAnimationFrame cadence; a display interpolation, not a new physical sample.

codex.name: Codex
codex.qualification: Retained 512² flux rasters interpolate the CT conserved state; they do not supply 512² independent solver cells. Missing outside the retained cell-centre support (outer radius about 2.293 AU).

frameSequence.physicalInterpolation: Bounded linear interpolation of physical flux between actual native epochs before logarithmic colour mapping.
frameSequence.browserInterpolation: Linear RGB opacity crossfade between adjacent 30 min display-support images at requestAnimationFrame cadence; a display interpolation, not a new physical sample.

claude.name: Claude
claude.temporalSource: Verified replay of the selected production solver with 30-minute slice output at existing 30-minute probe boundaries.
claude.qualification: The saved slice contains radial speed rather than the complete velocity vector.

temporalRefinement.integrationBoundaryPolicy: The original probe and slice clocks and their floating-point accumulation are unchanged. Extra read-only extraction after probe callbacks introduces no new timestep boundary.

frameSequence.physicalInterpolation: Every 30-minute display-support epoch is a native solver output from the verified production replay; only continuous browser playback blends adjacent image colours.
frameSequence.browserInterpolation: Linear RGB opacity crossfade between adjacent 30 min display-support images at requestAnimationFrame cadence; a display interpolation, not a new physical sample.

clock: Physical geometric UTC, not photon-arrival UTC.
timeMapping: video frame i corresponds to startMjd + i/(frameCount−1) × (endMjd−startMjd). Displayed UTC clamps at the final encoded frame.
temporalInterpolation: Claude uses verified native 30-minute solver re-outputs; Argon and Codex retain their original approximately 3-hour and 6-hour archives. Between native epochs, bounded linear physical-flux interpolation precedes logarithmic colour mapping. Display fps adds no independent simulation information.
spatialInterpolation: Bilinear interpolation from native retained plane samples directly to the 768² display raster; no 128² tile input, no extrapolation. Spatial display pixels are not independent solver cells.
projection: Sun-centred fixed-J2000 ecliptic x/y, viewed from ecliptic north; vernal equinox to the right. Argon cone is projected, not replaced by an ecliptic sample.
contrastDefinition: Native flux multiplied by true native-plane heliocentric radius² (AU²).
maskPolicy: A display pixel is missing if either bracketing native time sample has no finite positive source coverage; missing values retain the fixed background. No extrapolation across the radial support boundary.
loopPolicy: End-to-start wrap restarts the finite physical observation interval; it is not a periodic simulation.
defaultPlayback: Persistent paired 768px WebP layers, 30 min native or physically interpolated display support, continuous browser opacity crossfade. Native video downloads retained separately.
